local_decimals.checkpoint: before fast redeem or unstake transfer

transfer_amount_wei.meaning: amount of assets sent in the fast redeem or unstake transfer, in local 18-decimal wei
transfer_amount_wei.checkpoint: before fast redeem or unstake transfer

min_amount_ld_wei.meaning: minAmountLD set equal to assets (zero slippage tolerance) in _fastRedeem/_handleUnstake, expressed in the same local 18-decimal wei as the sent amount
min_amount_ld_wei.checkpoint: before fast redeem or unstake transfer

source_fee_paid.meaning: user paid source chain execution and LayerZero messaging fees for the transfer

destination_reverted.meaning: the transfer reverted on the destination chain
destination_reverted.checkpoint: after destination chain processing of the transfer

assumptions: The transfer amount and minAmountLD are both denominated in local 18-decimal wei; LayerZero dust removal truncates the shared-decimal amount before the slippage check.
The user is the party paying source chain execution and LayerZero messaging fees.
The fast redeem or unstake transfer is submitted via LayerZero OFT send.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the revert occurs on source or destination chain for each function, so the checkpoint of destination_reverted is only loosely grounded.

limitations: The impact is potential, not asserted; the plan encodes the reported fee-waste scenario as a liveness obligation without claiming it occurs.
Whether dust is 'almost guaranteed' is a claim, not a measured precondition; only the explicit non-divisibility condition is encoded.
